reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it actively promotes Mirror Trading International as a way to earn weekly trading income while requiring participants to fund an account and recruit others who make deposits. It emphasizes assurances such as 100% security and a transparent platform, then presents a binary compensation plan with two required recruits and a 10% bonus on their deposited funds. The closing instruction to call, sign up, and start earning makes this an active solicitation rather than neutral financial commentary.

citations.quote: Each member gets 40 percent of the trading profits once a week, which stays in the member's account with the broker.
To earn in the binary compensation plan, a American must sponsor one person on his left and another on his right with a minimum deposit $200
you will automatically receive a 10% direct referral bonus of the deposited funds
Call us! Sign up! And start earning today!

opening.argument: Judge the income language alongside the video's acknowledgment that trading can lose money. It asks whether viewers want to see "how profits or losses are generated" and says the daily statement reports "the profits or losses made for the day". Those are not promises of a fixed return. The stated weekly payment is a share of trading profits, which leaves open a week with no profits to share. The video makes strong claims about fund safety, but the record does not establish that it promises profitable trades regardless of market performance.

citations.quote: can see how profits or losses are generated
the profits or losses made for the day
Each member gets 40 percent of the trading profits once a week

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited weekly share describes a portion of profits, not an unconditional weekly return. The two-recruit requirement is expressly introduced as a condition "To earn in the binary compensation plan," which does not establish that recruitment is required to hold a trading account. And an invitation to sign up, although promotional, does not by itself resolve whether the underlying trading claims are false.

citations.quote: To earn in the binary compensation plan, a American must sponsor one person on his left and another on his right
Call us! Sign up! And start earning today!

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Mentioning possible losses does not undo the solicitation. The video tells viewers to fund an account, then offers weekly trading-profit shares and a referral bonus calculated from another person's deposit. Its closing call to sign up ties those earnings claims to immediate participation. The defense's market-risk reading leaves that recruitment-and-deposit pitch unanswered.

citations.quote: then fund the account
Each member gets 40 percent of the trading profits once a week
you will automatically receive a 10% direct referral bonus of the deposited funds
Call us! Sign up! And start earning today!

opening.argument: Much of the presentation walks through how the proposed account arrangement would operate: a member opens an account with a broker, authorizes mirrored trades through a limited power of attorney, and receives daily trade statements. The accompanying sequence diagrams registration, account opening and funding. A judge can read this as an explanation of a trading setup and its compensation terms, rather than treating every description of an operational step as proof that the arrangement is fraudulent. The material explains what participants are told will happen; it does not independently show whether those trades or statements occur.

citations.quote: simply open an account with the broker which will be KYC'd in your name using a special registration link
Members will then sign a limited power of attorney with the broker that allows MTI to mirror the Master Traders traded on to member's own trading accounts.
On a daily basis, you will receive a detailed statement of exactly what trades were taken, the profits or losses made for the day, etc.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening cites real compensation terms, but explaining those terms is compatible with an operational walkthrough. The left-and-right condition is stated for earning under one compensation plan; that quote alone does not establish that every viewer must recruit to use the trading arrangement. The closing invitation shows promotion, but promotion is not, on its own, evidence that the described trades are fictitious.

citations.quote: To earn in the binary compensation plan, a American must sponsor one person on his left and another on his right with a minimum deposit $200
Call us! Sign up! And start earning today!

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The operational steps are instructions for joining, not a detached tutorial. Viewers are told to use a special registration link and fund an account; the presentation then specifies two sponsored people, weaker-leg volume and a bonus on referred deposits. Whether actual trades occur is unresolved, but the video plainly promotes participation in a deposit-funded recruitment plan.

citations.quote: using a special registration link that will be provided to each member and then fund the account
must sponsor one person on his left and another on his right with a minimum deposit $200
based on the volume amount a member has on his weaker leg
a 10% direct referral bonus of the deposited funds

opening.argument: The described service is mirrored trading through an account opened with a broker, with a stated division of trading profits among members, MTI and traders. The speaker explicitly says members' funds do not go to MTI or the traders. That claim is unverified, but it matters when assessing what this video itself establishes: it does not show a viewer handing credentials or funds directly to the promoter. The referral payment is real, yet the presence of a referral incentive does not establish that trading is merely a pretext. On this record, the pitch can be understood as promotion of a trading service with an additional referral program.

citations.quote: we are in partnership with one of the world's largest ECN broker
It is noteworthy that all member's funds don't come to MTI nor the master traders in anyway
Each member gets 40 percent of the trading profits once a week
MTI also gets compensated with 10 percent of the trading profits, and the master traders get 30 percent.
you will automatically receive a 10% direct referral bonus of the deposited funds

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution identifies deposits and a referral bonus, but its quotes do not show that MTI receives members' deposited funds. The speaker instead places the account with a broker. Nor does a bonus on a referral deposit, by itself, disprove the separately described trading service. The evidence supports scrutiny of the offer, not certainty about what happens to deposited funds.

citations.quote: It is noteworthy that all member's funds don't come to MTI nor the master traders in anyway
simply open an account with the broker which will be KYC'd in your name
you will automatically receive a 10% direct referral bonus of the deposited funds

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The supposed broker arrangement is the promoter's assertion, not independent evidence that funds are safe. More importantly, the pitch does not stop at a trading service: it tells members to recruit on both sides of a binary plan, bases payouts on weaker-leg volume, and pays a direct bonus from a recruit's deposit. Those are the advertised earning mechanics, regardless of where the speaker says the accounts are held.

citations.quote: we are in partnership with one of the world's largest ECN broker who insures that all funds are safe to invest
must sponsor one person on his left and another on his right with a minimum deposit $200
based on the volume amount a member has on his weaker leg
you will automatically receive a 10% direct referral bonus of the deposited funds
